data.long_meaning: The name Franklin originated from Old English, derived from the names Frank meaning 'free' and lín meaning 'ruler'. It is a name of English, Greek, and Latin origin that carries the symbolism of freedom and leadership. The name Franklin carries the meaning “Free ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Franklin usually hope their child will grow to embody free ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Franklin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Franklin became synonymous with America's founding fathers and the ideals of democracy and independence. Many notable figures such as Benjamin Franklin and Franklin D. Roosevelt bore this name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Franklin reflects the belief in the divine right of every individual to be free from oppression and to rule their own lives as they see fit. It embodies the spiritual values of personal autonomy and leadership, resonating with the teachings of Christianity that emphasize individual responsibility and the power of faith in one's ability to overcome challenges.
